patterns.note: A grid-based layout with generous whitespace, using full-width sections and distinct content blocks that maintain a consistent horizontal alignment.
Extreme typographic contrast, pairing very large, thin, uppercase display headings with small, dense, uppercase monospaced labels for product details and navigation.
A high-contrast palette dominated by dark backgrounds and text, punctuated by a vibrant orange accent for calls to action, section backgrounds, and key information.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a smooth, staggered appearance of information.
Product information is presented in a highly structured, almost data-sheet-like format, using small, precise monospaced labels and values.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-viewport initial state with a large, abstract brand mark and product image that scrolls away to reveal subsequent content. Content sections below the hero employ scroll-triggered reveals, where elements animate into view with a subtle fade and upward translation as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated with CSS keyframes or a JavaScript animation library.
A persistent cookie consent banner is fixed to the bottom-left of the viewport, maintaining its position as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, thin, uppercase display headings (~6-8x body) with small, dense, uppercase monospaced labels and a balanced body text size.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounding on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and between major sections, with content blocks having balanced internal spacing, and dense, tightly packed monospaced labels.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of extreme typographic scale, blending a massive, thin, uppercase display font with tiny, dense monospaced labels. This creates a unique aesthetic that feels both minimalist and technically precise, elevating product details to an almost artistic presentation.
